meanings.note: Possession, relationships and many fixed expressions.
Tener algo claro means to understand it or have a firm view of it.

examples.text: Tiene muy claro lo que quiere.

examples.text: Va a ser solo un minutito.
examples.trans: It will only be one quick minute.

meanings.note: Stressed first-person singular pronoun after a preposition. Written with an accent, unlike possessive mi; may be doubled by unstressed me.

examples.text: No te preocupes. Quédate ahí tranquila,

examples.trans: If I hurry, I'll make it.

meanings.note: Subject pronoun; often omitted when the verb already identifies the person.
